helios.name: Helios
helios.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

helios-prime.name: Helios Prime
helios-prime.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
